notes:
- Solid Tatami finishes its last top stitch at an end marker placed across a cap. This applies to manually placed markers and automatic closest joins, including on concave fills.
- Shorten eligible Tatami Double Zigzag underlay connections while keeping the top stitch order and cutouts clear. Closed Double Zigzag fits whole stitch pairs into the available space.
- Shorten covered connections in eligible branches using Underlay First. The engine can reverse a complete Double Zigzag support pass without moving its stitch points.
